name: BME280
description: Bosch BME280 — combined temperature, humidity and barometric pressure sensor via I2C or SPI. PinPilot uses I2C mode.

alternatives.how: Connect SDO pin to VCC (3.3V) to select 0x77

notes: 3.3V device — do not connect to 5V supply. SDO to GND selects address 0x76 (default); SDO to VCC selects 0x77. The breakout board usually includes pull-ups on SDA/SCL; a second device on the bus does not need more pull-ups.
